detail.title: CP-UNR-4K4324-FI
features: Up to 32 channel IP camera input
AI disabled: 2-channel 16 MP@30 fps, AI enabled: 1-channel 16 MP@30 fps
AI disabled: 256 Mbps incoming, AI enabled: 180 Mbps incoming
Support 4 SATA ports, up to 16TB each, 3 USB (1 front USB 2.0 port, 2 rear USB3.0  ports)

General.Video Output: 1-channel VGA, 1-channel HDMI video output. HDMI: 3840 × 2160, 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 VGA: 1920 × 1080, 1280 × 1024, 1280 × 720 *Simultaneous/heterogeneous video sources output for VGA and HDMI is configurable.
General.Decoding Capability: AI disabled: 2-channel 16 MP@30 fps, 2-channel 12 MP@30 fps, 4-channel 8 MP@30 fps, 6-channel 5 MP@30 fps, 8-channel 4 MP@30 fps, 16-channel 1080p@30 fps AI enabled: 1-channel 16 MP@30 fps, 2-channel 12 MP@30 fps, 3-channel 8 MP@30 fps, 4-channel 5 MP@30 fps, 6-channel 4 MP@30 fps, 12-channel 1080p@30 fps
General.AI by NVR: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus
General.Resolution: 32 MP; 24 MP; 16 MP; 12 MP; 8 MP; 5 MP; 4 MP; 1080p; 720p; D1; CIF; QCIF
General.Network Bandwidth: 32 MP; 24 MP; 16 MP; 12 MP; 8 MP; 5 MP; 4 MP; 1080p; 720p; D1; CIF; QCIF
General.Perimeter Performance AI by NVR (Number: 2 channels, 10 IVS rules for each channel
General.Face Attributes: Gender; age group; glasses; expressions; face mask; beard
General.Face Detection Performance of AI by Reco: 2 channels (up to 12 face images/s each channel)
General.Face Database Capacity: Up to 20 face databases with 10,000 images, with a total capacity of 2.5 G. Name, gender,  birthday, address, credential type, credential No., countries & regions and state can be added  to each face image.
General.SMD Plus by NVR: 8 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by  leaves, rain and lighting condition change
General.Human Attributes: Top color, top type, bottom color, bottom type, hat, bag, age, gender and umbrella
General.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers. 2. Blocklist and allow list
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, snapshot, IPC external alarm output, audio, buzzer, log, preset, email
General.Hard Disk: 4 SATA ports, up to 16TB each. The maximum HDD capacity varies with environment temperature
General.Record Mode: General, motion detection; intelligent; alarm; POS
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, general playback, event playback, tag playback, smart playback (face and motion detection)
General.Interface Ports: 3(1 front USB 2.0 port, 2 rear USB 3.0 ports), 1 HDMI, 1 VGA, 1 RS232, 1 eSATA Port, 1 RS485
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, RTSP, UDP, SNMP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, PPPoE, FTP, DDNS, Alarm Server, IP Search, DH, Multicast, InstaOn cloud, Auto Registration, ONVIF 21.12(Profile T, Profile S, Profile G)
